title: Terminal-Bench 2.1: GPT-5.6 Sol and DeepSeek V4 routing comparison (N=3)
analysis_request: Compare N=3 complete runs for GPT-5.6 Sol direct, capable-first at confidence 0.3, and efficient-first at confidence 0.3. Use the direct group as the observed baseline and emphasize final pass@1, end-to-end model cost including routing-only token usage, run variance, task-aligned effects, model choice, cache efficiency, and routing-token accounting.

analysis_contract.primary_variation: sample standard deviation across three independent run-level observations
analysis_contract.cost_baseline: mean end-to-end model cost across the three GPT-5.6 Sol direct runs
analysis_contract.routing_overhead: dedicated switchyard.routing.llm_call ATOF usage marks, priced by the run-bound catalog and added without the excluded serving call
analysis_contract.paired_comparison: task-aligned per-configuration pass frequencies with a bootstrap interval over tasks; replicate indices are not treated as natural pairs
primary_plots: configuration mean pass@1 bars with individual runs and sample-standard-deviation error bars
configuration mean end-to-end model-cost bars with individual runs and sample-standard-deviation error bars
observed end-to-end cost versus the same-workload all-Sol counterfactual
secondary_sections: routing-only prompt, completion, reasoning, and cache-token accounting
